Imbued with excess and pain, the imagination of the dark mechanics forged the Sirenbow class Stalker.
Walking guns, they stalk across the battlefield picking off targets before they know it.

This kit includes everything you need to build a Sirenbow Stalkers in 8mm or AT scale.
The main body measures about the height of the standard Stalker.
This can be built in any number of ways, the kit is flexible with the legs and body being posable.

The kit includes, amongst standard components:
- 2 different feet
- 3 tail weapon options

Four files include:
1. Supported: individual components to print and pose as you desire.
2. Unsupported: as above but supported.
3. Complete: some example builds which you can use as an example or print as a single object. Supported versions included.

The model has been made to go on a 50mm bases and this has been included.


All files come supported and unsupported.

Pictures of models are test prints.
Pictured in the background are the [Rapture Heavy Stalkers](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/rapture-heavy-stalkers-8mm)

In the modern days, the mighty magicians of the Magnusons have to control their once glorious elite warriors. With the pass of centuries they've turned into mad-boys obsessed in scarabs, well they also lost their bodies but that's not important... They have to be controlled to stay focused on the battlefield and fight with their brothers until all the dust has gone.

This kit includes several pieces to convert your modern dusty scarab armored warriors and give them their glorious old days flavour.

Parts included (everything tartarus compatible):

- 5 torsos with heads
- 3 tabards from different cabals
- kopeshi combat weapons: axe and stave for band leader
- infernal shooting combi-weapon
- decorating bits for band leader: cape, stoles, spell book and enchantment scrolls
- shoulders in 2 designs and with 3 cabal symbols
- special shoulder for the band leader with 3 cabal symbols
- infernal missile rack adapter
- rotatory barrel to convert the warping flamer into a reaping cannon

As all my files, all the parts are presupported.

I'm making this series of miniatures to be Chaos Culitsts, however, without too much trouble you could use them to depict Sneaky Infiltrating Xeno-morphs. In fact, I've been playing the new Murder Squad a bit lately and while I like the look and the rules for the Bloody Treasonous Soldiers, they don't feel "chaos cultist" enough for me. So I'm going to run a Murder Squad of Sneaky Infiltrating Xeno-morphs which will 'count-as' Chaos Cultists. Hence, the reason why this fellow has a Las-cutter. Hey, Chaos Cultists come from all social strata of Imperial citizens too!

[UPDATE 2023-06-21]: Just like on Chaos Cultist #11 which I updated recently, I have moved the two wrenches on his backpack upwards so they are better supported and sturdier. I also made the battery cables on the las-cutter thicker. I think they look better and should be more sturdy.

The Excess God: Demon Chariots 5.0 bundle delivers a brutal and decadent vision of war at 10mm scale, featuring three distinct demon chariot models forged to embody speed, excess, and merciless destruction on the battlefield. Each chariot is designed with aggressive silhouettes, dynamic motion, and exaggerated details that remain crisp and readable even at small scale, making them ideal centerpieces for dark fantasy or infernal-themed armies.

Every model in this bundle is carefully optimized for high-quality resin printing. All miniatures come manually pre-supported using Lychee Slicer, with supports placed by hand to ensure reliable prints, minimal cleanup, and maximum preservation of fine details. The geometry is engineered to reduce unnecessary islands while maintaining structural strength, allowing for efficient and consistent printing across multiple copies.

These miniatures are created for miniature-agnostic tabletop games, giving players full freedom to use them across a wide range of custom systems and settings. They are not intended to replace, replicate, or act as proxies for any commercially licensed miniature ranges. For non-agnostic games, the use of original, officially licensed components is always recommended. Tordominis does not condone or support piracy in any form.

All distribution rights for these models are reserved exclusively by Tordominis. Official releases are available only through the Tordominis store on MyMiniFactory and through authorized physical miniature sellers. Any unauthorized sharing or distribution of these files, including via third-party websites, file-sharing platforms, or messaging services, is strictly prohibited.

This bundle is built for players and collectors seeking uncompromising detail, dark grandeur, and battlefield presence at epic scale.

Demon hordes for warmaster both with and without supports using Duncan Shadow's awesome demons.

10mm demon army
See my collections for the other units; I have a unit for each of the roles in warmaster revolution and a couple of heroes. Note that this army does not inherently match one of the big four chaos gods by design, as I find them dreadfully boring.

Supports
The supports are auto generated by Prusa. The strips are densely supported, but I haven't had any failures. The worst that's happened is me breaking off an arm of one of the demons on the edges of the strip when impatiently clipping through the supports.

Why?
I just got a 3d printer and was looking to get into warmaster with some friends when I noticed that there is no ready to print demon army yet. Given my 0-level modelling skills I instead decided to use existing models to create the army; this unit is one of the outcomes of this project.

Disclaimer
To be sure: none of these models are actually mine. I am a complete hack blundering his way through blender; all I can do is resize models, fatten segments and add cylinders (you may spot some of my handiwork on other models).
